note: P4116 (Pro 19:19) — a man of great wrath will pay the penalty; rescue him once, and you must do it again. (natsal = standalone.)

dims.v: hot temper — the man of great wrath, ever paying the penalty
the great wrath/hot temper of a man who repeatedly incurs penalty, and cannot be rescued once for all
the ungoverned rage that keeps landing its owner in trouble

chemah (wrath/hot anger) — 'a man of great WRATH will pay the penalty'; the incorrigibly angry keep incurring trouble — rescue them once and they need it again. Ungoverned temper is a recurring debt. Character must change, not just consequences be paid.
